bounds: Do not repeat rejected C2 zones/S06 or re-label them as new candidates. New defence hypothesis requires distinct evidence, prospective primary/benefit multiplicity, dated sources and a bounded budget before outcomes.

Before B1 fitting, freeze at most one distinct defence mechanism; at most three declared node variants, one200-game development screen and one disjoint200-game independent screen. Broader confirmation/stress requires a frozen survivor; reject unsupported comparisons honestly.

B2 first repairs historical Cup-final labels and season-specific calendar/version leakage. Freeze at most three starting-rating/memory candidates before validation; use the16 explicit origins in historical_pathway_panel from completed2022-23 through2025-26 seasons. Full-calendar/postseason calibration cannot be claimed from scheduled-only historical paths.

Fit carry-over/opponent/drift/absence auxiliaries strictly before each origin. Missing dated absence evidence retains no-hazard fallback; no arbitrary variance multiplier or from-final-results retune.

B2 selection uses leave-one-season-out; final historical confirmation or protected full-season truth must satisfy a prospectively explicit versioned pathway policy. Incomplete2026-27 final-season truth cannot establish calibrated title probabilities.
At most10 heavy threads including inner BLAS/OMP/compression. Parallelise disjoint panels/I/O; canonical1k chunks preserve world identity. No agent delegation implied.
Existing accepted history already shares shots across likely defenders in broad zones. Source audit must identify an actual new mechanism, not relabel the existing history as new work.
No defender positions exist at each shot in retained ESPN segments. Rank means likelihood, not measured physical proximity; top2 research hook is not proof of production activation.
Separate primary defence from help only if source evidence can support/validate it; unsupported roles stay unknown. Inferred weights must sumone per eligible shot; exclusions/missing fives explicit.

For per-origin forecasts all responsibility fits and profile histories precede origin. Hold out games for assignment validation; do not classify a made shot to a weak defender or missed shot to a strong defender based on that outcome.
U25 is PWA-only and delivered before B; use its design system rather than creating another website. Manual import remains required on both devices.

Historical season labels are ENDING years2023-26, not calendar-year origins. Exact16 dates are frozen above; none accesses protected2026-27 outcomes. Rotation maps require all weighted worlds, never selected extremes.

fallback: Retain accepted engines on negative/unsupported evidence. An unfinished investigation is not completion. Ship useful rotation/calibration visibility if no model improves. Preserve all prior sources/results and manual device-import limitation.
